description: One Square seller account per agent. The service polls Square for new orders, payments and refunds and wakes this agent with a short summary; the agent looks into the details with the Square MCP server.

accessToken.title: Access token
accessToken.description: Square Developer Console → your application → Credentials → access token for the environment chosen below (needs ORDERS_READ, PAYMENTS_READ and MERCHANT_PROFILE_READ). Stored encrypted; never shown again.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: production: connect.squareup.com. sandbox: connect.squareupsandbox.com. The token must belong to the same environment.

locationIds.title: Location IDs
locationIds.description: Square location IDs to watch, comma-separated. Empty: every active location of the account (looked up with MERCHANT_PROFILE_READ). Events at other locations are not reported.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to ask Square for changes (10–3600).

minAmount.title: Minimum amount
minAmount.description: Report only events of at least this amount, in the currency's main unit (1000 = ¥1,000 or $1,000). 0 reports every amount. Warnings are always reported.

notifyOrderCreated.title: New orders
notifyOrderCreated.description: order.created: an order created (or taken out of draft) since the last poll. An order that is already completed or canceled when first seen, such as a POS sale, is also reported when the toggle for that state is on.

notifyPaymentFailed.title: Payments failed or canceled
notifyPaymentFailed.description: payment.failed: a payment that ended FAILED or CANCELED.

notifyRefunds.title: Refunds
notifyRefunds.description: refund: a new refund, or a refund whose status changed.
